entry.title: How to Manual in Skate
entry.summary:
The Manual is one of the trickier skill moves to pull in Skate, and performing it correctly can be a true challenge.
Used very situationally, the Manual involves putting your weight on the lower part of your skateboard while slowly moving on the floor. It's advisable to perform the move on a flat surface. You'll also need to learn and master this trick to complete at least a couple of challenges inside the game.
Table of contents How to master the Manual in Skate? Skate Advanced Manual Techniques guide
How to master the Manual in Skate?
The controls for performing a Manual are relatively simple.
Press the RS button down lightly to push your weight on the lower end of your skateboard.
Hold the RS button down to keep doing Manual. The longer you hold down, the more Manuals you'll score.
Your highest chances of success will be on a floor, as I have shown in the screenshot. You can also perform them on raised platforms that have a flat top surface.
Ensure that your speed is slow/stationary.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Skate Advanced Manual Techniques guide
Once you master the art of manuals, you'll require it first in the Advanced Manual Techniques challenge. The quest requires you to perform two Flip tricks and two Manuals.
The easiest option for Flip Tricks is the Ollie. Simply flick the RS up, and you'll perform an Ollie.
For Manual, pause where you come down, stop, and hold the RS slightly down to perform the required move.
Make sure to stay in the assigned area to complete the challenges and proceed to the next one. Try out this fix if you're getting a bug trying to save your mission progression.

entry.title: How to complete Manual Beleaf challenges in Skate
entry.summary:
The Manual Beleaf challenges are among the toughest to complete in Skate, and finishing them in the correct sequence is a true test of your RS skills.
The quest involves you recreating three different skills separately across two small barriers that offer little moving room. However, you can complete the challenge with some simple tricks (if you fail, just try out the methods listed below).
Sake Manual Beleaf challenges guide
Here's a list of every task to complete.
Best Sequence (0/400)
Flip Trick
Manuals (2/2)
180 Spin
All the above in the same sequence
Out of the five tasks, don't pay much attention to Best Sequence. You'll have to complete the task using the two highlighted barricades.
Take two stacks of speed to start completing the objective.
As you approach the barrier, flick the RS up to perform an Ollie (Flip Trick).
Reduce the speed, and flick the RS gently down to complete the two Manuals.
Proceed with any 180-degree spin move, and repeat the sequence from the top.
In some instances, you could end up landing on a Grind. If that happens, use a 180-degree spin to move in the air before landing from the barrier to the ground.
Screenshot by Destructoid
If you land on the ground in between performing the sequence, you'll need to begin from the start. If you manage to complete your speed on the board, you can complete the tasks on the first barrier itself (which reduces the chances of failure). Controlling your speed isn't the easiest of jobs, but it's doable if you use the streamlined controls.
That's all you have to do to complete the Manual Beleaf challenges in the game. If you end up being unable to save your progression, try this fix to solve the issue at hand.

entry.title: How to fix map bug in Skate

Skate's map is the key to exploring places and completing objectives, but a bug has been popping up, causing problems for many players.

Skate map bug fix
The map bug can happen when you're about to start a new challenge. Ideally, the challenge will begin, and a spot on the map will be highlighted. You'll have to be physically present at the place to start and complete your tasks. But the bug prevents that from happening, which means that you'll have to guess the spot randomly. This is simply impossible to do, and here's what you can do instead.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Go to the Social tab from the main menu.
The Social tab allows you to invite and play with your friends.
You can also choose to spectate someone else who is currently live.
You can also teleport to that player's location.
The Teleport option will make you spawn to where your chosen player is present, and fix the map. If you open the map, you'll find the highlighted area. While the area might be far from where you're situated, it's still a piece of mind to know where you need to be.
Once done, you'll have to travel to the spot and continue with your missions. There's another bug that can happen and interrupt your mission progression. There's a fix for that as well that you can try out. The map bug fix mentioned here also doesn't require you to restart the game, saving more time in the process.

entry.title: Announcing support for World Builder-based games
entry.summary: After many years of development, games made with World Builder are ready for testing. The World Builder creation system was released for the original Macintosh and was extremely popular among developers. As such, we're announcing that over 160 games built on the engine are ready for public testing in ScummVM. Notable games made with World Builder include: Ray's Maze. The game follows Frank Farley, a part-time adventurer, who finds himself in a Maze full of dangerous monsters and deadly traps. The objective of the game is to solve puzzles and escape the maze. Radical Castle. You are given the role of a squire, who must bring back the stolen "Oracle" to the King to escape a fatal punishment. Enchanced Scepters. The first game created using World Builder, and one of the few commercial games made with it. The player must find fire, earth, air, and water scepters and bring them back to the castle. Most games made with WAGE are either freeware or shareware, and for your convenience we've collected all titles with these types into one big downloadable archive. So grab it from our game downloads page, get yourself a daily development build, and start your journey. As always, if you happen to have any issues, please submit the bug reports to our issue tracker. Lastly, contact us if you have some other unrecognised games or a new demo. >
